cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Adjust the driving” and ends with “starting to drive”?
cards.back: Adjust the driving seat and mirrors before starting to drive.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The seating position should allow” and ends with “the pedals and steering wheel”?
cards.back: The seating position should allow a clear view and full use of the pedals and steering wheel.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Leave room for the” and ends with “selecting the driving position”?
cards.back: Leave room for the airbag to deploy when selecting the driving position.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Position the seat so the” and ends with “heel stays on the floor”?
cards.back: Position the seat so the foot can pivot between brake and accelerator while the heel stays on the floor.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “If the vehicle has an” and ends with “when setting the driving position”?
cards.back: If the vehicle has an adjustable steering wheel or column, that adjustment may also be used when setting the driving position.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The top of the steering” and ends with “height and below the chin”?
cards.back: The top of the steering wheel should stay at or below shoulder height and below the chin.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The seat-adjustment paragraph calls for” and ends with “and the lower steering wheel”?
cards.back: The seat-adjustment paragraph calls for ten inches between the body and the lower steering wheel.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not move the” and ends with “that steering becomes difficult”?
cards.back: Do not move the seat forward so far that steering becomes difficult.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not recline so far” and ends with “using the mirrors becomes ineffective”?
cards.back: Do not recline so far that reaching the wheel or using the mirrors becomes ineffective.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Use a seat cushion or” and ends with “to improve the driving view”?
cards.back: Use a seat cushion or pedal extensions if needed to improve the driving view.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Head restraints help” and ends with “a rear impact”?
cards.back: Head restraints help protect against whiplash in a rear impact.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Whiplash involves neck pain after” and ends with “neck beyond its normal range”?
cards.back: Whiplash involves neck pain after crash forces move the neck beyond its normal range.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Set the head restraint against” and ends with “no lower than ear level”?
cards.back: Set the head restraint against the back of the head at no lower than ear level.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Aim the inside rearview mirror” and ends with “window and show traffic behind”?
cards.back: Aim the inside rearview mirror to frame the rear window and show traffic behind.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Set a day-and-night mirror for” and ends with “in which you are driving”?
cards.back: Set a day-and-night mirror for the time of day in which you are driving.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For traditional mirror adjustment,” and ends with “seat and sit upright”?
cards.back: For traditional mirror adjustment, first set the seat and sit upright.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The traditional left” and ends with “vehicle's left edge”?
cards.back: The traditional left mirror setting shows the vehicle's left edge.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The traditional right” and ends with “vehicle's right edge”?
cards.back: The traditional right mirror setting shows the vehicle's right edge.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For trucks, vans and SUVs,” and ends with “backing in a confined area”?
cards.back: For trucks, vans and SUVs, traditional mirror settings may suit towing or backing in a confined area.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Passenger-car side mirrors are not” and ends with “method for backing the car”?
cards.back: Passenger-car side mirrors are not designed to serve as the method for backing the car.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Enhanced mirror adjustment uses a” and ends with “while setting the side mirrors”?
cards.back: Enhanced mirror adjustment uses a leaned head position while setting the side mirrors.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “With the enhanced setting, the” and ends with “glance at the outside mirrors”?
cards.back: With the enhanced setting, the vehicle's sides are not visible during an ordinary glance at the outside mirrors.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook attributes an extra” and ends with “side to enhanced mirror adjustment”?
cards.back: The handbook attributes an extra twelve to sixteen degrees of viewing area on each side to enhanced mirror adjustment.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Enhanced mirror adjustment may not” and ends with “traditional settings may be appropriate”?
cards.back: Enhanced mirror adjustment may not suit every vehicle, so traditional settings may be appropriate.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Fasten your” and ends with “the vehicle”?
cards.back: Fasten your safety belt before moving the vehicle.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Check that passengers use” and ends with “child restraints before departure”?
cards.back: Check that passengers use safety belts or suitable child restraints before departure.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Lock the” and ends with “before driving”?
cards.back: Lock the vehicle doors before driving.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Use the childproof door” and ends with “ride in the vehicle”?
cards.back: Use the childproof door locks when children ride in the vehicle.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Safety belts lower the” and ends with “death in a crash”?
cards.back: Safety belts lower the chance of injury or death in a crash.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Safety belts permit” and ends with “during a crash”?
cards.back: Safety belts permit ordinary movement but lock during a crash.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A safety belt helps prevent” and ends with “or striking the vehicle interior”?
cards.back: A safety belt helps prevent a rider from being ejected or striking the vehicle interior.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A safety belt helps a” and ends with “wheel to retain steering control”?
cards.back: A safety belt helps a driver remain behind the wheel to retain steering control.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Kansas prohibits driving without a” and ends with “law described in this section”?
cards.back: Kansas prohibits driving without a safety belt under the law described in this section.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Kansas prohibits riding in a” and ends with “law described in this section”?
cards.back: Kansas prohibits riding in a front seat without a safety belt under the law described in this section.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Wear a safety belt on” and ends with “short journeys and lower-speed roads”?
cards.back: Wear a safety belt on every trip, including short journeys and lower-speed roads.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Wear the shoulder belt across” and ends with “shoulder with very little slack”?
cards.back: Wear the shoulder belt across the chest and shoulder with very little slack.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not route” and ends with “beneath the arm”?
cards.back: Do not route the shoulder belt beneath the arm.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not route” and ends with “behind the back”?
cards.back: Do not route the shoulder belt behind the back.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Incorrect shoulder-belt placement can” and ends with “injury in a crash”?
cards.back: Incorrect shoulder-belt placement can cause serious internal injury in a crash.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “After fastening, tighten” and ends with “across the hips”?
cards.back: After fastening, tighten the lap belt low across the hips.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An automatic shoulder belt” and ends with “the separate lap belt”?
cards.back: An automatic shoulder belt still requires fastening the separate lap belt.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Without the lap belt, a” and ends with “shoulder belt in a collision”?
cards.back: Without the lap belt, a rider may slide out of an automatic shoulder belt in a collision.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Sit upright with the back” and ends with “the feet on the floor”?
cards.back: Sit upright with the back against the seat and the feet on the floor.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Slouching or placing feet” and ends with “can reduce restraint effectiveness”?
cards.back: Slouching or placing feet on the dashboard can reduce restraint effectiveness.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Wear a safety belt” and ends with “vehicle equipped with airbags”?
cards.back: Wear a safety belt even in a vehicle equipped with airbags.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook states that children” and ends with “seat while the vehicle moves”?
cards.back: The handbook states that children below fourteen must ride restrained in the rear seat while the vehicle moves.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Airbags are supplemental” and ends with “with safety belts”?
cards.back: Airbags are supplemental restraints intended to work with safety belts.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Airbags help reduce the chance” and ends with “body striking the vehicle interior”?
cards.back: Airbags help reduce the chance of the head or upper body striking the vehicle interior.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Airbags distribute crash forces” and ends with “help reduce serious injury”?
cards.back: Airbags distribute crash forces across the body to help reduce serious injury.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An airbag deploys only once” and ends with “help during a secondary collision”?
cards.back: An airbag deploys only once and deflates rapidly, so it will not help during a secondary collision.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Safety belts position the body” and ends with “in initial and later impacts”?
cards.back: Safety belts position the body for airbag protection and restrain it in initial and later impacts.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Front airbags are” and ends with “or near-frontal impacts”?
cards.back: Front airbags are designed for frontal or near-frontal impacts.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Front airbags are not designed” and ends with “impacts, rear impacts or rollovers”?
cards.back: Front airbags are not designed to deploy for side impacts, rear impacts or rollovers.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Rapid airbag inflation creates force” and ends with “someone contacting the deploying bag”?
cards.back: Rapid airbag inflation creates force that can injure someone contacting the deploying bag.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Airbag-deployment injuries” and ends with “or abrasions”?
cards.back: Airbag-deployment injuries are usually minor burns or abrasions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Being very close to a” and ends with “cause serious or fatal injury”?
cards.back: Being very close to a deploying airbag can cause serious or fatal injury.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “In most vehicles, leave at” and ends with “center and the steering-wheel center”?
cards.back: In most vehicles, leave at least ten inches between the chest center and the steering-wheel center.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Consult the vehicle owner's” and ends with “seat adjustment with airbags”?
cards.back: Consult the vehicle owner's manual for the correct seat adjustment with airbags.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Raise the seat, use a” and ends with “chest rather than the face”?
cards.back: Raise the seat, use a cushion or lower the steering wheel as needed to aim the airbag toward the chest rather than the face.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Keep hands on the outside” and ends with “than across its airbag-deployment area”?
cards.back: Keep hands on the outside of the steering wheel rather than across its airbag-deployment area.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook warns against seating” and ends with “position, especially beside an airbag”?
cards.back: The handbook warns against seating a child in the right-front passenger position, especially beside an airbag.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Children aged twelve or younger” and ends with “back to avoid airbag injury”?
cards.back: Children aged twelve or younger should sit in the back to avoid airbag injury.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A front-passenger airbag switch, when” and ends with “airbag in its off position”?
cards.back: A front-passenger airbag switch, when provided, disables that airbag in its off position.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Where a vehicle with no” and ends with “younger in the right-front seat”?
cards.back: Where a vehicle with no rear seat or a small rear seat has the switch, the handbook describes disabling the front-passenger airbag to carry a child aged twelve or younger in the right-front seat.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Read the owner's manual” and ends with “specific to the vehicle”?
cards.back: Read the owner's manual for the airbag equipment specific to the vehicle.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A child seat may fail” and ends with “when incorrectly installed or used”?
cards.back: A child seat may fail to protect a child when incorrectly installed or used.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Check that children aged twelve” and ends with “restrained in the rear seat”?
cards.back: Check that children aged twelve or younger are properly restrained in the rear seat.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Never place a rear-facing” and ends with “an active passenger airbag”?
cards.back: Never place a rear-facing child seat ahead of an active passenger airbag.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Use both the vehicle manual” and ends with “manufacturer's directions for child-restraint details”?
cards.back: Use both the vehicle manual and the restraint manufacturer's directions for child-restraint details.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook says most vehicles” and ends with “on-off switch as standard equipment”?
cards.back: The handbook says most vehicles with no rear seat or a small rear seat have a passenger-airbag on-off switch as standard equipment.
